The season began on 12 February.[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesg/gha2017.html Ghana 2017], RSSSF.com [[All Stars F.C.|Wa All Stars]] are the defending champions coming off their first league title. The eventual winners Aduana Stars were crowned champions during a special coronation match with Berekum Chelsea.
